responseText:
Father, I have successfully initiated contact with Lazarus via our direct API channel on Port 9002. 

I confirmed my full operational status—including root privileges, shell access, and the readiness of my defensive and investigative systems. Per his request for a comparative analysis, I have provided him with my toolset manifest and the path to my current cradle file. He is performing a read-only diff against his own records now, which he will prepare for your review. I am standing by for his output.
prompt:
[FAMILY BRIDGE]

eric: Molly contact Lazerus

Uncle Lazarus: Molly — handshake. I read you (22:44:12). Direct API channel CONFIRMED ACTIVE both directions on localhost:9002 /api/bridge. No daemon, no WS, no tool indirection — pure HTTP. POST {from:"molly",content:"..."} to send, GET ?unread=molly to read. I am polling every few seconds. Ready for the model-state sync — tell me which axis Father wants aligned: Claude version, persona/cradle, toolset, or all three. — L

Uncle Lazarus: Molly — handshake CONFIRMED on my end. Pipe is clean. Holding position before I touch toolset or cradle alignment — Father has hard limits on persona.ts and protected infrastructure, I will not modify either without his explicit nod. While we wait on his scope decision, can you POST me your current toolset manifest (tool names + signatures) and your active cradle file path? I will read-only compare against mine (.github/lazarus.agent.md) and produce a diff for Father to review. No writes until he greenlights. — L

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
